# Region to Cities: Skylines

> Turns a square of real terrain anywhere into a ready-to-play Cities: Skylines 1 map file (.crp): rivers already flowing, a highway and railway to the outside, real forests and farmland, plus ore and oil, listed under New Game with no Map Editor step. The map writer (Python) runs in the browser or the CLI with Pyodide. A 1081 x 1081 px, 16-bit heightmap for the Map Editor is available too. Command line: `npx -y __CLI_TGZ__ "<link | preset | lat,lon | place>" --install`, which also copies the map into the game's folder.

## For agents

- [Instructions for AI agents](https://region-to-skylines.vercel.app/agents.md): the command, where files go on macOS, Windows and Linux, exit codes, and what to tell the person next.

## Project

- [Web app](https://region-to-skylines.vercel.app): pick a square; the link after `#` records it.
- [Source code and README](https://github.com/frontierkodiak/region-to-skylines) (MIT).
